### Figure 1. Temporal trends in exposure + outcome
```{r make-plot-items, warning=F, message=F}

ramadan_dates <- 
  data.frame(
    start = c(as.Date("2020-04-24"),
              as.Date("2021-04-13"),
              as.Date("2022-04-02")
              ),
    end   = c(as.Date("2020-05-23"),
              as.Date("2021-05-12"),
              as.Date("2022-05-01")
              )
  )

violence_counts <-
  df_violence %>% 
  mutate(event_date = floor_date(date, unit = "month")) %>%
  group_by(event_date) %>%
  summarise(
    events = n()
  )

df_monthly_all <- 
  df_all %>%
  group_by(visit_date) %>%
  summarise(
    rainfall_cm         = mean(r1h, na.rm = T),
    visits_per_1000_all = mean(n_visit_per_1000, na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(violence_counts,
            by = join_by("visit_date" == "event_date") )

df_monthly_mal <- 
  df_mal %>%
  group_by(visit_date) %>%
  summarise(
    visits_per_1000_mal = mean(n_visit_per_1000, na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_monthly_pne <- 
  df_pne %>%
  group_by(visit_date) %>%
  summarise(
    visits_per_1000_pne = mean(n_visit_per_1000, na.rm = T)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_monthly_dia <- 
  df_dia %>%
  group_by(visit_date) %>%
  summarise(
    visits_per_1000_dia = mean(n_visit_per_1000, na.rm = T)
    ) %>%
  ungroup()

df_monthly_merged <-
  df_monthly_all %>%
  left_join(df_monthly_mal, by = "visit_date") %>%
  left_join(df_monthly_pne, by = "visit_date") %>%
  left_join(df_monthly_dia, by = "visit_date") %>%
  mutate(visits_per_100K_all = visits_per_1000_all / 100,
         visits_per_100K_mal = visits_per_1000_mal / 100,
         visits_per_100K_pne = visits_per_1000_pne / 100,
         visits_per_100K_dia = visits_per_1000_dia / 100) %>%
  dplyr::select(visit_date, 
                rainfall_cm, 
                events,
                visits_per_100K_all,
                visits_per_100K_mal,
                visits_per_100K_pne,
                visits_per_100K_dia)

df_monthly_long <-
  df_monthly_merged %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = colnames(df_monthly_merged)[2:7], 
    names_to = "variable", 
    values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(
    variable = factor(
      variable,
      levels = c("rainfall_cm", 
                 "events", 
                 "visits_per_100K_all",
                 "visits_per_100K_mal",
                 "visits_per_100K_pne",
                 "visits_per_100K_dia"),
    labels = c("Rainfall (cm)", 
               "Total events",
               "Total visits (per 100K)", 
               "Malaria visits (per 100K)", 
               "Pneumonia visits (per 100K)", 
               "Diarrhea visits (per 100K)" )
  )) %>%
  mutate(value = if_else(is.na(value), 0, value))

df_monthly_long

```


```{r}

date_range <- c(
  min(df_monthly_long$visit_date),
  max(df_monthly_long$visit_date) + 30 )

levels(df_monthly_long$variable)

fig_1_ggplot <-
  ggplot(df_monthly_long, 
       aes(visit_date, value, color = variable)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = ramadan_dates,
    aes(xmin = start, 
        xmax = end, 
        ymin = -Inf, 
        ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = F, 
    fill = "grey70", 
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 1, 
             scales = "free_y", 
             strip.position = "left") +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = "6 months", 
               date_labels = "%b %Y") +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
  "Rainfall (cm)"               = "#0082B2",
  "Total events"                = "#D55E00",  
  "Total visits (per 100K)"     = mako(5)[2],  
  "Malaria visits (per 100K)"   = mako(5)[2],  
  "Pneumonia visits (per 100K)" = mako(5)[2],  
  "Diarrhea visits (per 100K)"  = mako(5)[2] ), 
  guide = "none"
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = date_range) +
  labs(x = NULL, 
       y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(strip.placement = "outside",
        strip.text.y.left = element_text(angle = 90),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

fig_1_ggplot

```



```{r save}

ggsave(
  paste0(figure_path,"fig_1_",Sys.Date(),".png"), 
   plot   = fig_1_ggplot, 
   width  = 9,
   height = 11,
   units  = "in",
   dpi    = 300)
```
